children: Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. (NYSE:GS) is expanding its ETF and asset-management reach—buying NEOS, taking XRP ETF exposure and backing crypto and leveraged products—while facing an SEC subpoena over a hedge fund crisis, advancing AI and FX strategies, and drawing trading and regulatory scrutiny.
Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. Buys NEOS
: Goldman Sachs (GS) is buying NEOS, an independent ETF firm, deal due to close Q1 2027. The move expands GS’s asset-management ETF footprint, adding leveraged and crypto-related ETF exposure.
SEC Subpoenas Goldman Sachs Over Hedge Fund Ties
: The SEC subpoenaed Goldman Sachs (GS) over its ties to hedge fund Situational Awareness and its AI-related July crisis, seeking details on the fund’s near-collapse and large portfolio sales.
Barron’s Volatility Trade On Goldman Sachs
: Barron's suggested a volatility trade on Goldman Sachs (GS): sell a GS put and buy a higher-strike call, effective entry near $107.35, targeting upside above $120.
Goldman Sachs Exposure To XRP ETFs

: Goldman Sachs reported about $86.5M exposure to five spot XRP ETFs, marking a new position after no prior XRP holdings, amid its asset-management expansion and proposed Neos Investments acquisition.
Goldman Sachs Urges Quick Banking Rule
: Goldman Sachs favors rapid finalization of a pending U.S. banking rule, while other big banks seek delays to protect lending; the Fed is weighing timing amid industry pressure.
Goldman Sachs Leads $240M Round For Owner
: Goldman Sachs (GS) led a $240M growth equity round in Owner, valuing it at $2.3B. Investment backs Owner’s AI marketing, websites, ordering, CRM and support, focused on independent restaurants.
Goldman Sachs FX Factor Framework Signals
: Goldman Sachs built a factor FX framework, trading long/short currency baskets across seven factors. Top current signals: positive for COP, BRL, IDR, AUD, NOK, CHF; negative for JPY, THB.
